name: bm-open
description: C→S bm.open (protocol 1.6): open that bookmark in a NEW tab. `nodeId` is a STRING because Chrome bookmark ids are strings, deliberately unlike the integer `tabId` of bm.star/bm.unstar. Reusing `id` for both would decode fine (the codec is value-lenient) and then fail SILENTLY at the extension — which is exactly why the two id fields are named apart.
